name: Bâtard-Montrachet
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Bâtard-Montrachet (#461). None establishes current farming.

namedPlots.coverageNote: BIVB lists one white Grand Cru spanning Puligny-Montrachet and Chassagne-Montrachet. The two exact cadastral spellings are audited on their respective sides of the commune line within one cru parcel set. BIENVENUES BATARD-MONTRACHET contributes only neighbouring edge contacts. The cru name also names a smaller constituent, so displayLayer stays false and white wines retain the entire INAO outline. No distinct official climat or producer holding is inferred.

neighbouringLieuxDits.reason: Three full parcels lie mostly outside this cru and touch its northern edge. Retain their printed cadastral name without treating the neighbouring Grand Cru as a Bâtard named subdivision.

reviewedOverlaps.note: The original clipped cadastral named-area polygons overlap by 4.144941 m² across the commune line. Preserve both published outlines; the union counts shared ground once. This is distinct from the parcel overlap measurement.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The 511.849881 m² remainder (0.431741%) was measured against both INAO communes and visually reviewed in an overview and all seven component views. Six components touch the INAO boundary: narrow western and northern edge strips, a 48.896868 m² gap along the commune line and a 26.247291 m² southeastern edge wedge. The seventh is a 1.514982 m² interior strip at the commune line, 0.864 m from the INAO edge, with a 0.143 m enclosing-rectangle width. No missing commune or detached missing parcel was found. The 511.9 m² cap allows less than 0.051 m² above the measured gap and is tied to exact source hashes. No geometry is clipped, buffered, filled or simplified.
